body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to two allies within 5 units. Each may immediately make a Basic Attack by committing its own dice normally.

surges.html: One affected ally may move 1 unit.
One affected ally regains 1 Stamina, Focus, or Mana.

rider.title: ORDER — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an ally within 5 units declares an Action: 1–3 gain +1 Defense until it resolves; 4–5 also gain +1 die; 6+ gain +1 die and 1 free Surge.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
